description: TRY_DECRYPT_RAW is the lenient sibling of DECRYPT_RAW: an identical round trip on good inputs, and SQL NULL rather than an error when the ciphertext, key or tag do not line up. The three-argument form compiles but cannot authenticate, so GCM without the tag yields NULL. The leniency does NOT extend to argument TYPES: a VARCHAR where BINARY is required is a compile error even for the TRY_ spelling, not a NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/TryDecryptRawTest (now retired); each round trip wraps ENCRYPT_RAW in a CTE so the object is produced once and its ciphertext, iv and tag members are read from it in the same statement.

steps.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('CAFEBABE', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C', 'HEX')) AS o) SELECT TO_VARCHAR(TRY_DECRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR, 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY(o:iv::VARCHAR, 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('', 'HEX'), 'AES-GCM', TO_BINARY(o:tag::VARCHAR, 'HEX')), 'HEX') FROM e

WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('CAFEBABE', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C', 'HEX')) AS o) SELECT TRY_DECRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR, 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('FF0102030405060708090A0B0C0D0EFF', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY(o:iv::VARCHAR, 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('', 'HEX'), 'AES-GCM', TO_BINARY(o:tag::VARCHAR, 'HEX')) FROM e

WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('CAFEBABE', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C', 'HEX')) AS o) SELECT TRY_DECRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR, 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY(o:iv::VARCHAR, 'HEX')) FROM e
